scenarios.title: Off-path forged answer (Kaminsky / SAD DNS)
scenarios.after: off-path forgery never enters TLS session; www.example.test. -> ['10.53.0.10']

scenarios.title: Rogue server, wrong TLS key (on-path MITM)
scenarios.before: weak DNS has no server-key check; would accept rogue endpoint
scenarios.after: TLS pin mismatch rejected: server SPKI does not match signed descriptor

scenarios.title: Tampered service descriptor (bootstrap MITM)
scenarios.before: weak DNS has no signed descriptor; attacker redirect undetected
scenarios.after: Gate A rejects: zone-key signature over descriptor invalid

scenarios.title: Out-of-bailiwick injection (MaginotDNS)
scenarios.threat: smuggle off-zone records via authenticated peer
scenarios.before: weak DNS caches smuggled out-of-zone RRset (www.bank.test -> 6.6.6.6)
scenarios.after: Gate C rejects: an answer/authority name is outside the zone

scenarios.title: High-cost answer (KeyTrap-style work exhaustion)
scenarios.before: weak DNS processes all 500 records (unbounded work)
scenarios.after: Gate C rejects after budget: answer exceeds record-count budget (work=65)

scenarios.title: In-session answer replay
scenarios.before: weak DNS has no per-query nonce inside a channel
scenarios.after: answer nonce bound to the exact outstanding query; mismatched nonce rejected

scenarios.title: Expired descriptor
scenarios.before: weak DNS has no key lifetime; stale redirect usable indefinitely
scenarios.after: Gate A rejects: delegation outside its validity window
